title: 808’s & Heartbreak 2015 Unreleased Artwork Tee By Nick Knight
description: Authentic Item. 808’s & Heartbreak 2015 Unreleased Artwork Tee By Nick Knight. On the albums 7th anniversary Ye put together a performance in Los Angeles for one single weekend. With the album receiving no supporting tour back in 2008, the 2015 performance sold out both nights. Although there was merch sold those nights, neither were this shirt, as the back design was not approved by artist Nick Knight. The shirt wasn’t sold due to copyrights but was handed amongst friends of Ye & his team. Measurements (Inches): XL 23.5 Width, 30 Length. Condition: DS.
